name: lemonade
source:
"Sometimes I think that leaving him would destroy me like nothing else in this world. Most of the time I try not to think about any of that."

"lemonade" is a furry short story in the form of a visual novel. It is told from two perspectives, showcasing a day in the lives of the protagonists from "[url=https://vndb.org/v46802]Warm Memories[/url]."

[From [url=https://ruiontheweb.itch.io/lemonade]Itch.io[/url]]
